claim: Six core learning activities are available without a purchase.
where: Landing page, station board, README, Terms
sandbox: Fresh demo context; open and complete the free path in every activity, then return to the board without a license prompt.

claim: Five guided activities end after three rounds; drawing ends after one saved open session.
sandbox: Fresh demo context; complete three rounds in each guided activity, then save one drawing and verify each completion state.

claim: The station works offline after the first visit.
where: Landing page, Adult tools, Privacy, README
sandbox: Fresh demo context; wait for service-worker control, disconnect, reload, complete and save an activity.

claim: The station can be installed from a supported Chromium browser.
sandbox: Fresh demo context; wait for service-worker control, then use Chromium CDP to assert a valid manifest and zero installability errors.

claim: Sample activity data stays isolated from the real station.
where: First-screen demo action, demo banner, README
sandbox: Change demo progress, leave with Start for real, revisit the demo, and verify its shipped sample is restored while real setup remains empty.

claim: Core activity progress stays on this computer; there are no analytics, ads, chat, cloud profiles, or third-party runtime scripts.
sandbox: Record every request while completing a core round from /demo; assert every request and runtime script is same-origin and no ad, chat, or frame exists.

claim: Adults can export and import valid JSON progress; malformed or impossible scores are rejected.
where: Landing page, Adult tools, Privacy, README
sandbox: At /demo export and re-import a valid file, then assert partial and negative-score files are rejected.

claim: Adults can erase all real local learning progress.
sandbox: Enter through demo, start a clean real station, save a round, confirm erase, and assert setup returns.

claim: Adults can print an anonymous local progress code.
sandbox: At /demo assert the code format matches the print sheet and that the sheet has no name or email field.

claim: Drawing supports keyboard controls and pointer or touch input.
sandbox: Open /demo/activity/drawing; add a shape by keyboard, dispatch a touch-style pointer stroke, and save.

claim: An available app update can be applied from the in-app notice.
sandbox: Replace a controlled worker with a real waiting worker, apply the notice, and assert controller change, reload, cache replacement, and the new worker marker.

claim: Adults can restore a valid ₹499 one-time license in Adult tools to add five-round sessions and detailed printouts.
where: Landing page, Adult tools, Terms, README
sandbox: At /demo paste a token through Adult tools, intercept a valid Sociobot response, finish five rounds, and assert recent practice appears in print.

claim: A restored license token and its latest validity result stay in this browser.
sandbox: Restore through Adult tools, then inspect localStorage, sessionStorage, and the demo IndexedDB database for the exact token and verdict locations.

claim: Restoring a license sends only its token to Sociobot and sends no age range, answers, drawings, or activity progress.
sandbox: Use seeded demo progress, restore through Adult tools, capture the request, and assert its GET query contains only the license token with no body or cookies.

claim: Stored licenses are verified with Sociobot at most once per day.
sandbox: At /demo intercept Sociobot verification, load twice with a stored token, and assert exactly one request.

claim: Activities can be set for ages 5–6, 7–8, or 9–10.
sandbox: From clean setup choose each age range and assert the station opens and a guided activity has distinct age-appropriate content.

claim: Adults can buy a ₹499 one-time workshop license through hosted Sociobot checkout and use the returned license.
where: Landing page, Adult tools, README, Terms
sandbox: From a clean landing page, follow the exact checkout link into a recorded hosted-checkout response, assert the request carries no local progress, then return with a fixture license and verify it is stored, removed from the URL, checked, and unlocked.
